msgs:
I AM NOT LAZY.
I AM IN
ENERGY SAVING MODE

EVERYTHING IS
GOING TO PLAN.
THERE IS NO PLAN.

TURN IT OFF
AND ON AGAIN

I'm not late.
I make a
dramatic entrance

Mornings aren't
good. They're
with coffee

The couch is
calling. I can't
say no

Everything is
under control.
Almost

Opened the fridge.
No inspiration

I'm on a diet.
Day two.
Hour one

Laziness is
the engine
of progress

Exercise? I'm
charging
my phone

The weekend flew
by like five
minutes

Monday is hard.
The rest
aren't easier

Something went
wrong.
As usual

The cat thinks
this is
his apartment

I'm not asleep.
I'm testing
the pillow

Lots of plans.
Energy for one

The key is
to look confident

No idea what's
happening,
but I'm in

Coffee didn't help.
Need another

It will be fine.
Probably

Productive day:
I ate

Got a spoon?
Then cake isn't
scary

I'm allergic
to Mondays

Important things
can wait.
I'm having tea

Tried thinking
positive.
Got tired

Age is when you
get tired
of resting

If anything,
I didn't
touch it

Diet lasts until
the first cookie

Say no to stress.
Say yes
to cake

Life is like
a zebra: stripes
of coffee

I can wake up
early. But why?

The cat has plans
for my chair

I'm not here.
I'm on vacation
in my head

Almost ready.
Mentally

We're not late,
the clock
is early

Socks vanish
in pairs.
Then one by one

The washing machine
eats socks. Proven

Phone at 10%.
Panic {r}

No Wi-Fi?
Time to talk
to people

Wi-Fi password?
Ask Mom

Order is knowing
where the mess is

I'm not lazy.
I'm saving
energy

Today: a day of
great non-
achievements

Better late than
early morning

Never trust
the bathroom scale

My workout:
reaching for
cookies

One day I'll
sort this drawer

Secret of a good
day: second
breakfast

It's not a mess.
It's a creative
process

Early to rise,
early to want
a nap

Sunday is
pajama day
My plan: a nap

Optimist: the glass
is half full
of coffee

Got cookies?
Then I'm yours

Hungry me is
not me

Made breakfast.
Firefighters
are coming. Joking

The floor is
also a shelf

Payday is
an eternity away

I'm not shouting.
I'm speaking
with enthusiasm

Keep calm and
eat a cookie

Cat on the
keyboard. Work
is canceled

Pizza smell
inspires me

Mornings: zombie.
After coffee:
human

The remote is
missing again

Where do weekends
go?

I'm only here
for the food

Don't wake
the morning in me

No questions
before coffee

May all problems
solve themselves

The cat runs
this house

Life is getting
better: Friday!

My sport: running
from problems

I look calm,
but mentally
I'm on vacation

Reading the manual
means something
broke

Give me a minute.
Or two.
Or an hour

Assembled the
wardrobe. Spare
screws left

The dog ate
my homework

Not today,
Monday

Time flies when
I'm late

I remember
everything
except the
important stuff

Bought dumbbells.
Carried them
home. Enough

I want a vacation
from my vacation

If you read this,
switch on
the kettle

I mostly train
my laugh muscles

Too much to do?
Start with lunch

Dream: to catch up
on sleep
by retirement

Can't beat it?
Order pizza

Everyone owes
me a cookie

Working remotely:
from work

A person is
a cat without
a tail

Hooray, Saturday!
Sleeping till noon

"Do not disturb"
mode: on

I'm thinking.
About lunch

Don't mix up
salt and sugar

Happiness: money
in an old jacket

Perfect weather.
For the couch

Doctor said
walk more.
I walk to
the kitchen

Great day for
doing nothing

Thought about
sports. Got tired
of thinking

Who hid my
glasses? They're
on my head

Looking for my
phone using
my phone

Why do today what
can wait
till tomorrow?

I have everything.
Just not where
it should be

My cat: head of
the sleep department

Healthy lifestyle:
healthy sleep

Best exercise:
push-ups off
the couch

Can I just
lie here?

Energy: 0%.
Charm: 100%

Is it curable?
Yes. Friday

I don't snore.
I dream I'm
a motorcycle

My diet plan:
tomorrow

Running late,
but looking
great

Adulting is
mostly laundry

Nap: the
grown-up recess

Coffee first.
Adulting later

I came, I saw,
I forgot why
I came

My hobbies:
snacks and naps

Five more
minutes. Or ten

I'd agree with you,
but then we'd
both be wrong

Plot twist:
I made dinner

Home chef,
professional
taster

I put the "pro"
in procrastinate

Professional
couch tester

My bed and I
are in a serious
relationship

Today's mood:
snacks

Brain: loading...
{y}{y}{y}

Running on
coffee and
good vibes

Warning: may
spontaneously
talk about cars

I'm not arguing.
I'm explaining
why I'm right

Life update:
still hungry
